jobs.title: Software Engineer 2 - .NET - Allegro Klik/Care
jobs.description:
Location:
Warszawa, PL, 00-841

Company: Allegro Pay sp. z o.o.

Team: Technology

Contract Type: Employee

Allegro Pay is Central Europe's largest and fastest growing fintech - the only place where financial solutions can be created on such a large scale, using state-of-the-art technology. We work on purchase financing and payment methods that are used daily by customers of Allegro, the most popular shopping platform in Poland and one of the largest e-commerce companies in Europe. Due to this scale, we have the opportunity to work on one of the most exciting purchase financing and payment solutions in our country. We are looking for talented people who want to create powerful and stable solutions to support a product with over a dozen million active users.

  

#### **The role**

  

We're looking for a Software Engineer with solid, proven experience in .NET and backend development to join a cross-functional team focused mainly on greenfield projects — building new products and features from the ground up. You'll take ownership of designing and delivering seamless, end-to-end customer journeys — from opening a bank account and activating a fast payment method directly within the Allegro app, through funding the account, to authorizing payments and rewarding customers with cashback, all in just a few taps. Alongside building new features, you'll drive improvements in system performance, scalability, and reliability, and help raise the quality and maintainability of our codebase. You'll work closely with product, design, and business stakeholders, translating ideas into robust technical solutions, and collaborate with and support less experienced teammates as the team grows.

  

Our team builds and scales two products:

  

* **Allegro Klik** - lets Allegro users link an existing bank account or open a new one directly within the Allegro app for instant payments with cashback. We own the full flow: account linking and opening, payment processing, top-ups, cashback calculation and cashback-driven promotional campaigns.
* **Allegro Care** - insurance offered directly in the Allegro shopping experience, letting customers protect their purchases (e.g. against damage, theft, or with extended warranty) right at checkout, with policy management handled seamlessly within the platform.

Both products are growing fast, with new initiatives launched continuously alongside scaling of our existing systems.

  

### **Important things for you:**

  

* Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.
* The salary range for this position depending on the skill set is as follows (contract of employment, tax-deductible cost):

  + PLN gross 14 600 - 20 825
  + Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.
* Our team is based in Warsaw and Poznań.

### **Here's why you should join us:**

  

* **AI-Adoption strategy:** we invest a lot of effort to upskill our specialists and equip them with the newest AI coding technologies like Copilot or OpenCode.
* **Big Scale:** immerse yourself in the exciting world of Allegro Pay, where your .NET skills will tackle challenges on a large scale. You'll be contributing to financial solutions that affect over 2.5 million people (handling 60+ million requests daily and managing dozens of terabytes of data).
* **Engineering Maturity:** Join a culture that mirrors the top tech giants. Our commitment to engineering excellence and maturity puts us on par with industry leaders like FAANG companies. (11 of 12 in Pragmatic Engineer Score)
* **Best-in-Class Expertise:** Work alongside the best experts in the field, collaborating to push the boundaries of what's possible in FinTech. Our team includes MVPs and many conference speakers.
* **Impactful Products:** Imagine this – your work at Allegro Pay contributes to creating products that you, your family, and friends might already use daily. See the direct impact of your efforts on the FinTech landscape (with 120+ deployments per month).

### **We are looking for people who:**

  

* Have solid, hands-on experience with **.NET** and backend development, and are ready to apply it on production-grade systems
* Have practical experience with **distributed systems and microservices**; exposure to partner APIs is a plus
* Are comfortable working with cloud infrastructure(preferably **Azure**)
* **Want to be proud of the code they create;** value high-quality code reviews and engage in substantive discussions on software engineering best practices
* Are eager to understand the broader business context and communicate effectively with internal clients
* Demonstrate a high sense of responsibility and resilience, as you will be working with critical financial data
* **Are enthusiastic about AI** and are open to actively incorporating AI coding assistants (such as GitHub Copilot) into their daily work to maximize efficiency and focus on complex problem-solving
* **Can independently design and deliver effective solutions** to the requirements set by business stakeholders, taking full ownership of the features they build from start to finish
* Are committed to continuous learning, open to constructive feedback, and embrace a growth mindset through active participation in code reviews, backlog grooming, team discussions and retrospectives
* Collaborate effectively within a team, share knowledge, and are willing to support less experienced teammates as the team grows
* Speak fluent Polish (essential for daily communication with internal and partner stakeholders) and communicative English (at least B2 level)

### **What's in it for you:**

  

* Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).
* A 16" or 14" MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories.
* A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).
* English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.
* A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings.
* An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal.
* Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy.

And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here.

  

### **#goodtobehere means that:**

  

* You will join a team you can count on - we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.
* You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.
* You will value our Developer Experience and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job.
* You will be equipped with modern AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support).
* You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!) by your friends, family and millions of our customers.
* You will meet the Allegro Scale, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300k+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning.
* You will become part of Allegro Tech - We speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about!

Send us your CV and... see you at Allegro!

**Don’t wait until you join us! Let's meet online!**
----------------------------------------------------

Get to know our team, take a peek at our office life and check out what else we do at Allegro.

jobs.title: MJUKVARUUTVECKLARE FULL STACK JAVA eller C#
jobs.description:
**Tillsammans arbetar vi med modern teknik och utvecklar innovationer som bidrar till säker, hållbar och smidig mobilitet inom Automotive.**

**Vad innebär rollen för dig?**  
Du kommer att bli en del av digital-team inom Engineering hos kund inom Automotive. Teamet utvecklar digitala lösningar som skall hjälpa att minska koldioxidavtrycket per enhet.

Arbeta med moderna verktyg och agila metoder för att kontinuerligt skapa affärsvärde. Samtidigt lägger vi stor vikt vid kvalitet, flexibilitet och ett bra samarbete – och självklart har vi roligt tillsammans under resans gång.

**Din vardag**  
Vi söker seniora mjukvaruutvecklare till teamet och rollerna innebär främst arbete med utveckling, underhåll och support.

En del av arbetet kommer att innebära utveckling i ett MOTS-system (modifiable off-the-shelf), som används för att hantera materialinformation. Samtidigt finns det behov och möjligheter att utveckla andra applikationer och integrationer inom området utanför MaterialCenter.

I teamet arbetar du tillsammans med flera tvärfunktionella produktteam som kontinuerligt levererar nya funktioner och förbättringar. Du kommer att bidra till att kunden kan utveckla mer hållbara produkter genom insikter baserade på materialdata – från tekniska, infrastrukturella, process- och supportperspektiv.

**Dina kompetenser**  
Du är en erfaren mjukvaruingenjör med stark drivkraft att lösa problem och en hjälpsam inställning i ditt arbete. Oavsett om det handlar om domänkunskap eller ny teknik är du öppen för att lära dig nytt och skapa verkligt värde tillsammans med andra skickliga utvecklare.

Du bidrar till en trygg och inspirerande teamkultur där man hjälper varandra, delar kunskap och ber om stöd när det behövs. Tillsammans med teamet och lösningsarkitekten driver du också förbättringsarbete.

Du är engagerad i ditt arbete och fokuserar på att leverera affärsvärde. Du håller dig uppdaterad kring bästa praxis inom mjukvaruutveckling, exempelvis principer som single responsibility, automatiserad testning och god kodkvalitet.

Eftersom materialområdet är centralt i rollen är det också viktigt att förstå hur våra intressenter arbetar och hur systemen kan stödja exempelvis materialtestning, CAE-simulering och miljöpåverkan. Erfarenhet inom dessa områden eller ett starkt intresse är meriterande.

**Dina erfarenheter (måste ha)**  
Erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling i Java eller C#  
God kunskap inom frontendutveckling för webben (gärna React, JavaScript, Node)  
Utveckling och driftsättning av cloud-native applikationer i Microsoft Azure (App Services, Functions, Key Vault, Storage m.m.)  
Erfarenhet av MOTS-utveckling (gärna MaterialCenter eller liknande) Erfarenhet av integrationer  
REST-API  
Snowflake  
Python DevOps / CI/CD  
SQL-databaser och datastrukturer  
Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt

**Meriterande kompetenser**  
GitHub JavaScript RegEx GraphQL Data mining / Machine Learning

jobs.title: IT Manager / Systems Programmer (India & South Asia)
jobs.description:
We arelooking for a highly skilled and hands-on
  
  
IT Manager / Systems Development Manager
  
  
to establish and lead our IT office in India. The successful candidate will beresponsible for building customized software solutions, automating businessprocesses, developing integrated systems, and driving digital transformationinitiatives across our operations.
  
  
This roler equires strong expertise in
  
  
system programming, software architecture, process automation, database management,and enterprise application development
  
  
.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Set up and manage the company's IT and software development office in India.

Automate operational, financial, HR, fleet management, and reporting processes.

Strong hands-on experience in system programming and software customization.

Strong knowledge of ERP, CRM, Transport Management Systems (TMS), and workflow automation.
  
  
Experience in developing and maintaining mission-critical business applications.
  
  
Excellent leadership, project management, and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Additional MandatoryRequirements

Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and customizing Transport Management Systems (TMS).

Proven track record of integrating ERP, CRM, GPS tracking, telematics, and accounting systems.

Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.

Ability to travel frequently between India and Singapore.
  
  
Preferred Requirements
  
  
Previous experience in transportation, logistics, fleet management, or mobility businesses.
  
  
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Power Platform, Dynamics 365, Power BI, and AI-driven automation.
  
  
Experience establishing software development teams in Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, or Pune.
  
  
Familiarity with Singapore business operations and regulatory requirements.
  
  
Preferred Experience
  
  
Transport, logistics, fleet management, or supply chain industries.
  
  
Enterprise system design and architecture.
  
  
Artificial Intelligence, machine learning, or intelligent automation projects.
  
  
Microsoft Azure, Power Platform, SharePoint, Dynamics 365, or similar platforms.
  
  
Mobile apps and web application development.
  
  
Key Objective
  
  
The primary objective of this role is to buildan in-house technology capability in India to automate business functions, customizesoftware solutions, integrate systems, improve operational efficiency, andsupport business growth across South Asian markets.
  
  
Remuneration
  
  
Attractive salary package.
  
  
Performance-based incentives.
  
  
Career advancement opportunities.
  
  
Opportunity to build and lead a dedicated technology centre from the ground up.
  
  
Interested candidates should submit a detailed CV highlightingtheir experience in system programming, software development, automationprojects, and IT leadership.
  
  
Special Note
  
  
Only candidates with hands-on experience in systems programming,enterprise software customization, process automation, and setting up softwaredevelopment operations in India will be considered.

jobs.title: .NET Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**The Team**

Sportcast is widely recognized as the leader in sports betting player engagement through their product experiences, technologies and pricing. We invented BetBuilder, and our award-winning original continues to pioneer sports betting experiences. Billions of combinations, within single sporting events, immerse players deeply in the story they build. Players want more. More access to every possible betting opportunity, every event combination, for every sport. Thrilling betting moments. Created by players. Now part of OpenBet. We've brought together the developers, statisticians, data scientists powering the future of sports betting. They build the odds and prices for billions – and soon trillions - of game eventualities. The ultimate features. Any combination. Every sports story.

**SportCast x OpenBet** is a team that you want to be part of! Come join us.

We are looking for a passionate **.Net Software Engineer** to support Sportcast's growth from our European offices.

As a Software Developer in the Trade team, you will work as part of a cross-functional team that develops, deploys, and supports its own projects and outcomes. You will have the opportunity to work on varied projects to write testable and maintainable code. Being a team player, you will enjoy participating in team design, scoping, and prioritisation discussions. These teams' focus is to assist the business in delivering scaling while also maintaining high quality.

The role will involve the development and maintenance of our real-time systems.

**What you will be doing**

* Develop high quality, high-performing code which meets the business need.
* Optimise our solutions to ensure we support our service levels and minimise cloud costs.
* Automate processes wherever possible.
* Challenge the status quo. Help improve our patterns, standards and procedures across the organisation.

**The Player**

* 3+ years of experience with .NET/.NET Core and C#
* Exposure to Unit Testing, Serverless technologies such as Azure Functions, and containerized microservices using Azure Container Apps or AWS equivalents
* Expertise in SQL-based databases including MSSQL and PostgreSQL
* Experience with GitHub/ GitFlow workflow branch strategy
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to diverse audiences
* Effective team player in cross-functional, multi-disciplinary teams, with a strong collaborative mindset
* Strategic and resourceful problem solver, focused on delivering secure, scalable, and value-driven solutions iteratively
* Exposure to high-volume, mission-critical systems with performance and reliability requirements
* Prior experience in the wagering or gaming industry is a plus

**What’s the Score?**

**What We Can Offer YOU**

* We have a collaborative hybrid office environment with our team members at least 3 days per week.
* Attractive benefits, an open and supportive environment as well as a modern and exciting workplace
* The opportunity to interact with global teams on a regular basis as you and our business continues to develop & grow
* Tangible and genuine development - at OpenBet, you can take your career where you want it to go!
* And if that’s not enough; enjoy flexible working whilst we provide you with the guidance and development skills you need to progress and enhance your career

At OpenBet, we celebrate diversity and believe in creating an inclusive environment where every voice is valued and respected. We're committed to building a team that reflects the rich tapestry of humanity, embracing individuals from all walks of life, backgrounds, and identities. Join us in shaping the future of iGaming, where diversity isn't just celebrated—it's celebrated.
